recursos.label: Resources & Links
recursos.gold: Stick to at most 2 font families (e.g. Poppins + JetBrains Mono) and load only the weights you actually use (400, 600, 700) to protect your LCP.

t1_frameworks.label: 1. Pick Framework
t1_frameworks.gold: If your site is a landing page, portfolio or blog that needs to rank on Google, choose Astro: it ships 0 KB of JS by default.

t2_firebase.label: 2. Astro + Firebase
t2_firebase.gold: During 'firebase init hosting', set 'dist' as the public directory and answer NO to 'Single-Page App' so Astro serves clean multi-page HTML.

t3_vercel.label: 3. Astro + Vercel
t3_vercel.gold: If your Astro site is 100% static on Vercel, skip installing any adapter: connect GitHub and Vercel detects Astro automatically.

t4_cloudflare.label: 4. Astro + Cloudflare
t4_cloudflare.gold: When deploying with pnpm on Cloudflare Workers, add 'packages: ["."]' to pnpm-workspace.yaml and set NODE_VERSION = 22.14.0 to avoid build errors.

t5_combo.label: 5. Pro Combo + SEO
t5_combo.gold: Split responsibilities: Astro + Cloudflare for free global edge speed, Firebase for Auth/Firestore, and /imgwii + /seo-test before launch.

t6_email_routing.label: 6. CF Email Routing
t6_email_routing.gold: If you send a test email from the same destination Gmail to your @domain, Gmail hides it to prevent loops. Always test from a different inbox.

t7_resend_worker.label: 7. Worker + Resend
t7_resend_worker.gold: Never prefix your Resend API key with PUBLIC_ in .env. Store it as a Secret in Cloudflare Workers and always include a User-Agent header.

t1_frameworks.title: Which Framework Should You Choose?
t1_frameworks.desc: Don't over-engineer. Picking the right framework saves months of maintenance and directly shapes your Google Speed score.
t1_frameworks.example: John wants to build 'my-business.com' to rank on Google and win clients. He compares Astro vs Next.js vs Vite/React first.

steps.title: Step 1 · For SEO and 95–100 Speed: Astro
steps.desc: Astro outputs clean HTML and only hydrates JavaScript where needed. It is the modern standard for fast, rankable websites.

steps.title: Step 2 · For complex stateful SaaS apps: Next.js
steps.desc: When almost every screen depends on user sessions, server mutations, and dynamic protected routes, Next.js shines.

steps.title: Step 3 · For private internal panels without Google indexing: Vite + React
steps.desc: Internal tools (ERP, POS, private admin) don't need SEO; Vite boots in milliseconds.
